item.g:title: Blenheim MDF Skirting Board
item.g:description: Ornate traditional profile designed for period properties and classically styled interiors. Available in 25mm and 30mm depths and heights from 170mm to 350mm, with an 88mm profile detail at every height. Lengths of 3050mm or 4200mm, unprimed or primed, with optional cable or pipe rebates. Made from moisture-resistant MDF with a smooth, knot-free surface ideal for painting.
